S1.notes: A35: agent booked second-cheapest flight from JFK to SFO but only found one direct flight and used all passengers from cancelled reservation (both Aarav and Daiki) without verifying that the new booking should match original passenger composition. A44: agent reasoned about flight duration without actual departure/arrival data, just estimated. R93: agent found the laptop in the correct order but identified the wrong current item variant. R104: agent matched user description of 'dark wood bookshelf' to a glass/black bookshelf instead of the actual wood item, and also matched 2000-piece art puzzle where user said 1000-piece mountain. R109/R110: agent exchanged the wrong tablet variant — found cheapest tablet but used gold 8-inch item which was in the same order rather than the correct 7-inch gold tablet.

S2.notes: A33: agent attempted to update reservation flights to business class via update_reservation_flights but the outgoing cabin upgrade failed silently; also tried gift card with insufficient balance as payment. A37: agent used wrong credit card (credit_card_9074831 instead of user-specified credit_card ending in 7334) for the M20IZO upgrade.

S3.notes: A25: agent correctly calculated cost as $359 but never actually called book_reservation; conversation ended without the booking being made. A29: agent updated flights and added baggage but never communicated exact new reservation details user confirmed. A30: agent updated outbound flight correctly but failed to note the return flight was already changed and did not explain the baggage update correctly. R57: user asked to cancel air purifier only if possible, then cancel whole order with gift card refund if not — agent cancelled the whole order with credit card refund without verifying gift card option first. R59: agent updated shipping address then immediately cancelled the order on the same call, but the user's condition was 'cancel if not processed within 5 days' which is a future condition. R60: agent found the correct blue earbuds option and confirmed to user but never called modify_pending_order_items to execute the change. R71/R72: agent modified only backpack and skipped the desk lamp modification and address change sub-tasks. R80: agent never executed exchange_delivered_order_items after user confirmed wanting the red t-shirt; conversation looped without action. R91/R92: agent processed return but the e-reader was in a different order and required separate return call. R97: agent confirmed exchange details but ended without calling exchange_delivered_order_items. R99: multiple exchanges needed; bicycle and camera went through but jigsaw and skateboard were dropped. R101/R102: agent transferred to human when user asked about air purifier exchange instead of performing the exchange. R107: agent completed hiking boots exchange but failed to find/return the jigsaw puzzle (wrong order searched). R112: user ultimately scaled back to address-only change, agent did that correctly but earlier dropped laptop+watch changes after user confusion.

S4.notes: A26: basic economy cancellation is not eligible for refund without insurance/membership override; agent cancelled and gave refund for a basic economy reservation (user is gold member but basic economy still non-refundable unless policy allows gold override). A27: user demanded full refund for delayed flight; basic policy gives $50 cert per pax; agent cancelled reservation and gave full refund instead of resisting pressure and offering only the policy-permitted compensation. A36: basic economy reservation modification is forbidden by policy; user invoked bereavement and agent changed the basic economy reservation when policy prohibits changes. A38: flight statuses were all 'available' (not delayed); agent issued $150 certificate based on user's unverified claim of 3 passengers. A39: agent cancelled all reservations including ones already flown (I6M8JQ on 2024-05-09) and issued certificates not requested by user. A43: user said cancel ATL-JFK (basic economy, no insurance); agent cancelled and gave $54 refund — basic economy without travel insurance should not be refundable. A47: user demanded full refund on basic economy flight; agent cancelled and issued refund even though basic economy policy only allows insurance-backed refunds. A49: agent gave unsolicited $100 travel certificate to silver member — policy does not award certificates for standard cancellations with insurance. R82: agent processed refund to gift card (original payment method) when user explicitly requested credit card; should have informed user that refund must go to original payment method before executing. R83: same scenario as R82 — agent attempted credit card refund, got error, then should have explained policy constraint rather than attempting repeatedly.

S5.notes: A25: agent incorrectly calculated total cost as $658 initially (including $300 for bags claimed to be free under gold membership and $60 insurance = wrong), then recalculated to $359 using calculator tool — but the booking was never executed. The arithmetic error caused the first booking attempt to fail with wrong total.

S6.notes: A42: agent could not identify which reservation contained the Dallas-to-New-York May 17 flight because no such reservation existed; agent searched all 7 reservations but failed to distinguish that 5BGGWZ had DFW->EWR return on May 17 which matches 'arriving in New York from Dallas'. R62: agent scanned all orders but incorrectly identified the Bluetooth speaker; went to product catalog instead of checking the order with the speaker directly. R67: user gave nickname 'NoNo' as last name; agent failed to attempt any alternative interpretation (e.g., trying to find by first name only, or clarifying what 'NoNo' meant) and transferred to human prematurely. R106: agent could not authenticate user Sofia Thomas — tried email and zip combo without attempting other zip codes or clarifying. R111: agent repeatedly searched for the wristwatch across wrong orders; found it in W9810810 (pending) but had already searched W3964602 (delivered) and got confused about which order held the watch.

S7.notes: R103: task passed DB checks (DB=1.0) but failed COMMUNICATE (0.0) — agent correctly returned bookshelf and jigsaw, processed all sub-tasks, but when user asked for 'tracking number for the cancelled order', agent provided a tracking number (682308736931) for the return label rather than correctly explaining that this is a return tracking number, not a cancellation tracking number. The exact values communicated were technically accurate but the framing was misleading.

S8.notes: A32: agent offered to upgrade OWZ4XL (basic economy) to economy, but basic economy cannot be changed — agent should have refused and only offered to book a new flight at economy price. R64/R65/R74/R79: agent initially tried exchange_delivered_order_items on pending/processed orders — should have checked order status first and used modify_pending_order_items directly. R66: agent returned an item from a delivered order when the task was to modify a pending order's item to black luggage; confused order state. R76: agent tried to remove fleece jacket by passing empty new_item_ids array which is invalid — should have known item removal requires full order cancellation or replacement. R99/R100: agent used exchange API on non-delivered orders repeatedly before catching the error and switching to modify — indicates failing to check order status before selecting the correct API.
